कौट 1. कौट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटि), living in
one's own house, independant, free; domestic, homely,
home-born, home-bred; (अस्), m. = कुटज, the plant
Wrightia Antidysenterica.
—कौट-तक्ष, अस्, m.
an independant carpenter, one who works at home
on his own account and not for the village or cor-
poration.

कौट 2. कौट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कूट), snared,
wired; fraudulent, dishonest; (अम्), n. fraud, false-
hood.
—कौट-साक्षिन्, ई, m. a false witness, = कूट-
साक्षिन्.
—कौटसाक्ष्य, अम्, n. false evidence.

कौटकिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose occupation is
to catch animals in traps, caves, &c.; (अस्), m. a
vender of the flesh of birds or beasts, a poacher, a
butcher, &c.; [cf. कौटिक.]

कौटिक, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose business is to catch
animals in traps &c.; one who kills animals and sells
their flesh for his own subsistence, a hunter, a poacher,
a mountaineer, &c.; relating to a snare or trap;
fraudulent, dishonest.

कौटज कौटज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटज), coming
from the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica; (अस्), m.
the plant Wrightia Antidysenterica.
—कौटज-भा-
रिक, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying or bearing a load of
Wrightia Antidysenterica.

कौटजिक, अस्, ई, अम्, carrying a load of Wrightia
Antidysenterica.

कौटभी कौटभी, f. an epithet of the god-
dess Durgā; [cf. कैटभी.]

कौटल्य कौटल्य, अस्, m. an epithet of
Cāṇakya; also called Vātsyāyana; [cf. कौटिल्य.]

कौटवी कौटवी, f. a naked woman; [cf.
कोट्टवी.]

कौटिलिक कौटिलिक, अस्, m. (fr. कुटिलिका),
a hunter; a blacksmith.

कौटिल्य कौटिल्य, अस्, m. (fr. कुटिल), an
epithet of Cāṇakya [cf. कौटल्य]; N. of a gram-
marian; (अम्), n. crookedness, curvature, curliness
of the hair; falsehood, fraudulent behaviour, dis-
honesty, deceit, insincerity; a kind of horse-radish.

कौटीर कौटीर, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the
plant Kuṭīra, made of it.

कौटीर्या, f. an epithet of Durgā, ‘living in a
hut (?).’

कौटुम्ब कौटुम्ब, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कुटुम्ब),
necessary for the household; (अम्), n. family relation-
ship.

कौटुम्बिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a family,
constituting a family; having relations; (अस्), m. the
father or master of a family.
